heading: We follow carbon and contaminants
from the soil to the sea
about_section.intro: CLEAR WATER LAB is an environmental chemistry group at TerraNova Institute. We measure how carbon, nutrients and pollutants move through soil, air and water — and we build the instruments that keep those measurements running through winter storms and summer tides.
